```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num FROM (
        SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) rn
        FROM inventories
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
explode AS (
    -- parts directly in the set's current inventory
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ci.set_num = '41067-1' AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    UNION ALL
    -- nested sets
    SELECT e.part_num, e.qty * ins.quantity
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON TRUE
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.id = ins.inventory_id
    JOIN explode e2 ON e2.part_num = e.part_num
    WHERE FALSE
)
SELECT 1;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM (
        SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn
        FROM inventories
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
target_color AS (
    SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Tan'
),
-- parts directly in a set's own current inventory (non-spare), for 2018 sets
direct_parts AS (
    SELECT ci.set_num AS root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM sets s
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE s.year = 2018 AND ip.is_spare = false
),
-- nested sets directly in a set's own current inventory
direct_sets AS (
    SELECT ci.set_num AS root_set, iset.set_num AS child_set, iset.quantity AS qty
    FROM sets s
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE s.year = 2018
),
-- minifigs directly in a set's own current inventory
direct_figs AS (
    SELECT ci.set_num AS root_set, im.fig_num, im.quantity AS qty
    FROM sets s
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE s.year = 2018
),
-- recursive expansion of nested sets: (root_set, set_num, multiplier)
set_expand AS (
    SELECT root_set, child_set AS set_num, qty AS mult FROM direct_sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT se.root_set, iset.set_num, se.mult * iset.quantity
    FROM set_expand se
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = se.set_num
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
),
-- parts from nested sets (each nested set's own current inventory)
nested_parts AS (
    SELECT se.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, se.mult * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM set_expand se
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = se.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
),
-- parts from minifigs (each minifig's own current inventory)
fig_parts AS (
    SELECT df.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, df.qty * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM direct_figs df
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = df.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
),
all_parts AS (
    SELECT * FROM direct_parts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM nested_parts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM fig_parts
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ap.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM all_parts ap
JOIN target_color tc ON tc.id = ap.color_id
WHERE ap.part_num = '2454b';
```

```sql
cur AS (
  SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS version
  FROM u_composition
  GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
-- recursive explosion of set 21123-1
explode AS (
  -- start: one unit of the set itself
  SELECT 'set' AS kind, '21123-1' AS num, 1 AS qty
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.child_kind, c.child_num, e.qty * c.qty
  FROM explode e
  JOIN cur ON cur.parent_kind = e.kind AND cur.parent_num = e.num
  JOIN u_composition c
    ON c.parent_kind = e.kind AND c.parent_num = e.num AND c.version = cur.version
  WHERE c.child_kind IN ('set','minifig')
)

JOIN cur ON cur.parent_kind = e.kind AND cur.parent_num = e.num
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE set_contents(set_num, part_num, quantity) AS (
    -- Direct parts in the set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        s.set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.quantity
    FROM sets s
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE s.set_num = '80033-1'
      AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = s.set_num)
      AND ip.is_spare = false

    UNION ALL

    -- Parts from nested sets
    SELECT 
        sc.set_num,
        sc.part_num,
        sc.quantity * ins.quantity
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = sc.set_num
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip2 ON ip2.inventory_id = i2.id
    WHERE i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ins.set_num)
      AND ip2.is_spare = false

    UNION ALL

    -- Parts from minifigs
    SELECT 
        sc.set_num,
        sc.part_num,
        sc.quantity * im.quantity
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = (SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = sc.set_num AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = sc.set_num))

    JOIN inventory_parts ip3 ON ip3.inventory_id = i3.id
    WHERE i3.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
      AND ip3.is_spare = false
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num FROM (
        SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) rn
        FROM inventories
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT set_num FROM sets WHERE year = 2012
),
-- explode nested sets: track (root_set, nested_set, multiplier)
set_tree AS (
    SELECT ts.set_num AS root_set, ts.set_num AS cur_set, 1 AS mult
    FROM target_sets ts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT st.root_set, ins.set_num, st.mult * ins.quantity
    FROM set_tree st
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = st.cur_set
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = ci.id
),
-- parts from sets (own inventory parts, scaled by multiplier)
set_parts AS (
    SELECT st.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, st.mult * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM set_tree st
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = st.cur_set
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
),
-- minifigs contained in sets
set_minifigs AS (
    SELECT st.root_set, im.fig_num, st.mult * im.quantity AS qty
    FROM set_tree st
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = st.cur_set
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
),
-- parts from minifigs
minifig_parts AS (
    SELECT sm.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, sm.qty * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM set_minifigs sm
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = sm.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
),
all_parts AS (
    SELECT * FROM set_parts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM minifig_parts
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT root_set)
FROM all_parts
WHERE part_num = '2431'
  AND color_id = (SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Dark Brown');
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Get the current inventory version for any item (set or minifig)
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        set_num,
        MAX(version) AS max_version
    FROM inventories
    GROUP BY set_num
),

-- Start with the set we're interested in
starting_point AS (
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        1 AS quantity_multiplier
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.max_version
    WHERE i.set_num = '41067-1'
),

-- Recursive CTE to explore all inventories and their parts
recursive_explode AS (
    -- Base: the starting set's inventory
    SELECT 
        sp.inventory_id,
        sp.quantity_multiplier,
        0 AS depth
    FROM starting_point sp
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add nested sets' inventories (find current inventory of each nested set)
    SELECT 
        i2.id AS inventory_id,
        re.quantity_multiplier * iset.quantity AS quantity_multiplier,
        re.depth + 1
    FROM recursive_explode re
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = re.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.max_version
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = iset.set_num AND i2.version = ci.max_version
    WHERE re.depth < 10  -- safety limit
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add minifigs' inventories (find current inventory of each minifig)
    SELECT 
        i2.id AS inventory_id,
        re.quantity_multiplier * im.quantity AS quantity_multiplier,
        re.depth + 1
    FROM recursive_explode re
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = re.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON i.set_num = ci.set_num AND i.version = ci.max_version
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = im.fig_num AND i2.version = ci.max_version
    WHERE re.depth < 10  -- safety limit
),

-- Get all parts from all explored inventories
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        SUM(re.quantity_multiplier * ip.quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM recursive_explode re
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = re.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
      AND ip.part_num = '15573'
    GROUP BY ip.part_num, ip.color_id
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_quantity), 0)::INTEGER AS total_units
FROM all_parts
```

```sql
    -- Get current inventory version for each set/fig
    SELECT id, set_num, MAX(version) as max_version
    FROM inventories
    GROUP BY id, set_num

    -- Current inventory entries for sets

    FROM inventories i
    JOIN current_inventory ci

),
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from set's inventory (excluding spares)
    SELECT 
        si.set_num as root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity as total_quantity
    FROM set_current_inventory si
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = si.id
    WHERE ip.part_num = '90641'
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from nested sets (recursively)
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ec.total_quantity * ip.quantity as total_quantity
```

```sql
        iset.set_num AS part_num,  -- we'll treat set_num as identifier for recursion

        iset.quantity AS multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM inventory_sets iset
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL

        im.fig_num AS part_num,  -- we'll treat fig_num as identifier for recursion
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    -- Get current inventory version for set 71746-1
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '71746-1'
    AND version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '71746-1')
),
```
```sql
set_contents AS (
    -- Base case: start with set 71746-1, multiplier 1
    SELECT 
        'set' AS item_type,
        ci.set_num AS item_id,
        ci.id AS inventory_id,
        1 AS multiplier
    FROM current_inventory ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets (from inventory_sets)
    SELECT 
        'set' AS item_type,
        is2.set_num AS item_id,
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        sc.multiplier * is2.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_sets is2 ON is2.inventory_id = sc.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = is2.set_num
    WHERE sc.item_type = 'set'
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs from any set inventory
    SELECT 
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id,
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        sc.multiplier * im.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = sc.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    WHERE sc.item_type = 'set'
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
),
all_parts AS (
    -- Parts from sets (excluding spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        sc.multiplier * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = sc.inventory_id
    WHERE sc.item_type = 'set'
    AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from minifigs (excluding spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        sc.multiplier * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = sc.inventory_id
    WHERE sc.item_type = 'minifig'
    AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_quantity), 0) AS total_units
FROM all_parts ap
JOIN colors c ON c.id = ap.color_id
WHERE ap.part_num = '15619'
AND c.name = 'Dark Green'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    -- Get current inventory version for each set/fig
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base: start with set 60299-1
    SELECT 
        'set' as item_type,
        '60299-1' as root_set,
        '60299-1' as current_item,
        1 as quantity_multiplier
    UNION ALL
    -- Parts directly in inventory (leaf nodes, don't recurse further)
    SELECT 
        'part' as item_type,
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num || '|' || ip.color_id as current_item,
        ec.quantity_multiplier * ip.quantity as quantity_multiplier
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ec.current_item
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ec.item_type != 'part'  -- Don't recurse from parts
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: recurse
    SELECT 
        'set' as item_type,
        ec.root_set,
        iset.set_num as current_item,
        ec.quantity_multiplier * iset.quantity as quantity_multiplier
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ec.current_item
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ec.item_type != 'part'  -- Don't recurse from parts
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: recurse (treat as having their own inventory)
    SELECT 
        'minifig' as item_type,
        ec.root_set,
        im.fig_num as current_item,
        ec.quantity_multiplier * im.quantity as quantity_multiplier
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ec.current_item
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ec.item_type != 'part'  -- Don't recurse from parts
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifig parts (leaf nodes)
    SELECT 
        'part' as item_type,
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num || '|' || ip.color_id as current_item,
        ec.quantity_multiplier * ip.quantity as quantity_multiplier
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ec.current_item
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ec.item_type = 'minifig'
      AND ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity_multiplier), 0) as total_parts
FROM exploded_contents
WHERE item_type = 'part';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE set_contents(set_num, item_type, item_id, quantity) AS (
    -- Direct inventory items for each set (current inventory only)
    SELECT 
        i.set_num,
        CASE 
            WHEN ip.part_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'part'
            WHEN im.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'minifig'
            WHEN iset.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'
        END AS item_type,
        COALESCE(ip.part_num, im.fig_num, iset.set_num) AS item_id,
        COALESCE(ip.quantity, im.quantity, iset.quantity) AS quantity
    FROM inventories i
    LEFT JOIN inventory_parts ip ON i.id = ip.inventory_id AND ip.is_spare = false
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON i.id = im.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON i.id = iset.inventory_id
    WHERE i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(i2.version) 
        FROM inventories i2 
        WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num
    )
    AND (ip.part_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL OR iset.set_num IS NOT NULL)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive expansion: nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        sc.set_num,
        CASE 
            WHEN ip.part_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'part'
            WHEN im.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'minifig'
            WHEN iset.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'
        END AS item_type,
        COALESCE(ip.part_num, im.fig_num, iset.set_num) AS item_id,
        COALESCE(ip.quantity, im.quantity, iset.quantity) * sc.quantity AS quantity
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = sc.item_id
        AND i.version = (
            SELECT MAX(i2.version) 
            FROM inventories i2 
            WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num
        )

    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON i.id = im.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON i.id = iset.inventory_id

    AND (ip.part_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL OR iset.set_num IS NOT NULL)
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the current inventory version for set 66495-1
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '66495-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

-- Recursively find all nested sets and their current inventories, tracking quantities
nested_sets AS (
    -- Base: start with the top-level set
    SELECT 
        ci.inventory_id,
        1 AS set_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find nested sets within each set's inventory
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        ns.set_quantity * is2.quantity AS set_quantity
    FROM nested_sets ns
    JOIN inventory_sets is2 ON is2.inventory_id = ns.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = is2.set_num
    -- Get current version of nested set's inventory
    WHERE i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = i.set_num
    )
),

-- All inventories to check for minifigs (both top-level and nested sets)
all_inventories AS (
    SELECT inventory_id, set_quantity FROM nested_sets
),

-- Sum minifig quantities across all inventories, accounting for set nesting multipliers
minifig_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        im.fig_num,
        SUM(ai.set_quantity * im.quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM all_inventories ai
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ai.inventory_id
    GROUP BY im.fig_num
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_quantity), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM minifig_counts
```

```sql
-- Get the current inventory for the target set
target_inventory AS (
    SELECT id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '42677-1'
    ORDER BY version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts from the target set's inventory (including spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity,
        ip.is_spare
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN target_inventory ti ON ip.inventory_id = ti.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: multiply quantities
    SELECT 
        ec.part_num,
        ec.color_id,
        ec.total_quantity * isets.quantity AS total_quantity,
        ec.is_spare
    FROM inventory_sets isets
    JOIN target_inventory ti ON isets.inventory_id = ti.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = isets.set_num
    -- Get current inventory of nested set
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) latest ON latest.set_num = inv.set_num AND inv.version = latest.max_version
    JOIN exploded_contents ec ON 1=1
    -- We need to join with inventory_parts of the nested set's current inventory
    JOIN inventory_parts nip ON nip.inventory_id = inv.id 
        AND ec.part_num = nip.part_num 
        AND ec.color_id = nip.color_id
        AND ec.is_spare = nip.is_spare
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: multiply quantities
    SELECT 
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        im.quantity * mip.quantity AS total_quantity,
        mip.is_spare
    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    JOIN target_inventory ti ON im.inventory_id = ti.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories minv ON minv.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mlatest ON mlatest.set_num = minv.set_num AND minv.version = mlatest.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = minv.id
),
-- Proper recursive approach: start from target inventory and recurse through nested items
recursive_explode(inventory_id, part_num, color_id, quantity, is_spare) AS (
    -- Direct parts from current inventory
    SELECT 
        ti.inventory_id,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity,
        ip.is_spare
    FROM target_inventory ti
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ti.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: find their current inventory and include their parts
    SELECT 
        inv.id,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        re.quantity * isets.quantity * ip.quantity,
        ip.is_spare
    FROM recursive_explode re
    JOIN inventories parent_inv ON parent_inv.id = re.inventory_id
    JOIN inventory_sets isets ON isets.inventory_id = parent_inv.id
    JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = isets.set_num

    -- Minifigs: find their current inventory and include their parts
```

```sql
-- Get the current inventory version for set 41319-1
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '41319-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents: parts, nested sets, and minifigs
-- We track the multiplier from quantities along the path
exploded AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts from the set's inventory (including spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty,
        FALSE AS is_from_minifig
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: nested sets from the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        NULL AS part_num,
        NULL AS color_id,
        iset.quantity AS qty,
        FALSE AS is_from_minifig
    FROM inventory_sets iset
    WHERE iset.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: minifigs from the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        NULL AS part_num,
        NULL AS color_id,
        im.quantity AS qty,
        TRUE AS is_from_minifig
    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    WHERE im.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
),
-- Need to recursively process nested sets and minifigs
-- Let's restructure: start with inventory items and recurse
recursive_explode AS (
    -- Base: all items in the current inventory of 41319-1
    SELECT 
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        CAST(ip.quantity AS BIGINT) AS total_qty,
        ip.is_spare,
        1 AS level
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS part_num,  -- using part_num column to store set_num
        NULL AS color_id,
        CAST(iset.quantity AS BIGINT) AS total_qty,
        FALSE AS is_spare,
        1 AS level
    FROM inventory_sets iset
    WHERE iset.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS part_num,  -- using part_num column to store fig_num
        NULL AS color_id,

        FALSE AS is_spare,
```

```sql
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ec.part_num = ci.set_num  -- part_num here is actually a set_num from previous level
```

```sql
-- Get the color ID for Medium Azure
medium_azure AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Medium Azure'
),
-- Get all inventories with their current version

    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all parts at any level
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts in set inventories (excluding spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: parts from minifigs (excluding spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        im.quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN current_inventories ci_mf ON ci_mf.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci_mf.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets
    SELECT 
        ep.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ep.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ep.root_set
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN current_inventories ci_nested ON ci_nested.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci_nested.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets containing minifigs

        ep.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ep.total_quantity * im.quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity

    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ep.root_set
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN current_inventories ci_nested ON ci_nested.set_num = ins.set_num

    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci_mf.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current inventory IDs for all sets
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (set_num) 
        id AS inventory_id, 
        set_num
    FROM inventories
    ORDER BY set_num, version DESC
),

-- Recursive expansion of inventory contents
-- We track: the root set, current item being expanded, quantity multiplier, and item type
expanded_contents AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts in set inventories (excluding spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: parts from minifigs in set inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        (im.quantity * mip.quantity) AS qty_multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories mi_ci ON mi_ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = mi_ci.inventory_id
    WHERE mip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets
    -- We need to expand nested sets' contents
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (ec.qty_multiplier * ip.quantity) AS qty_multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type
    FROM expanded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ec.part_num  -- ec.part_num holds the set_num for nested sets
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ec.item_type = 'set'
      AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets' minifigs
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        (ec.qty_multiplier * im.quantity * mip.quantity) AS qty_multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type
    FROM expanded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ec.part_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories mi_ci ON mi_ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = mi_ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ec.item_type = 'set'
      AND mip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: propagate nested sets for further nesting
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        iset.set_num AS part_num,
        NULL AS color_id,
        (ec.qty_multiplier * iset.quantity) AS qty_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM expanded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ec.part_num
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ec.item_type = 'set'
),

-- Need to also include the initial nested sets from the base inventory
initial_nested_sets AS (
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        iset.set_num AS part_num,
        NULL AS color_id,
        iset.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
)

-- Combine everything: direct parts, minifig parts, and recursively expanded nested sets
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT root_set) AS num_sets
FROM (
    -- Direct parts and minifig parts from base
    SELECT root_set, part_num, color_id, qty_multiplier, item_type
    FROM expanded_contents
    WHERE item_type = 'part'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Initial nested sets that need expansion
    SELECT root_set, part_num, color_id, qty_multiplier, item_type
    FROM initial_nested_sets
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- All parts from recursive expansion of nested sets
    SELECT ec.root_set, ec.part_num, ec.color_id, ec.qty_multiplier, ec.item_type
    FROM expanded_contents ec
    WHERE ec.item_type = 'part'
      AND ec.root_set IN (SELECT root_set FROM initial_nested_sets)
) all_contents
WHERE part_num = '76797'
```

```sql
    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON ci2.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci2.id
    WHERE ip.part_num IS NOT NULL
),

nested_sets AS (
    -- Base: direct nested sets in root sets
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        iset.set_num AS nested_set,
        iset.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets within nested sets

        ns.root_set,
        iset.set_num AS nested_set,
        ns.qty * iset.quantity AS qty
    FROM nested_sets ns
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ns.nested_set
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id

nested_parts AS (

        ip.part_num,

        ip.is_spare
    FROM nested_sets ns
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ns.nested_set
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    
    UNION ALL

        ip.part_num,
        ns.qty * im.quantity * ip.quantity AS qty,
        ip.is_spare
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the color ID for Lime
lime_color AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Lime'
),
-- Get current inventory IDs for all sets
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents at any level
-- We track: the original set, current inventory being explored, item type, item ID, quantity multiplier
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with all sets' current inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ci.id AS inv_id,
        'set' AS item_type,
        ci.set_num AS item_id,
        1 AS qty_mult
    FROM current_inventories ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts directly in current inventory (we'll check these later)
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        ip.inventory_id AS inv_id,
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num || '|' || ip.color_id::VARCHAR AS item_id,
        e.qty_mult * ip.quantity AS qty_mult
    FROM exploded e
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
```

```sql
        i.id,
        i.set_num,
        i.version
    FROM inventories i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num

),

    -- Base: direct minifigs in set inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        im.fig_num,
        im.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON ci.id = im.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        im.fig_num,
        ec.qty * im.quantity AS qty
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ec.fig_num = ci.set_num  -- fig_num can be a set_num (nested sets)
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON ci.id = im.inventory_id
    WHERE ec.fig_num LIKE 'fig-%'  -- only continue if current is actually a set (not a real minifig)
)
SELECT DISTINCT root_set
FROM exploded_contents
WHERE fig_num = 'fig-004629'
ORDER BY root_set;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the color ID for Trans-Brown
trans_brown_color AS (
    SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Trans-Brown'
),
-- Get current inventory for each set
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all parts at any level
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base case: parts directly in set inventories (excluding spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: add parts from nested sets
    SELECT 
        ep.root_set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ep.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = ep.root_set_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: add parts from minifigs
    SELECT 
        ep.root_set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ep.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = ep.root_set_num
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
)

SELECT DISTINCT root_set_num AS set_num
FROM exploded_parts
WHERE part_num = '4864b'
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the color_id for Lime
lime_color AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id
    FROM colors
    WHERE name = 'Lime'
),

-- Get all inventories with their set_num/fig_num and current version
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents of sets
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts in set inventories (non-spare)
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: parts from minifigs directly in sets
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        im.quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN current_inventories ci_mf ON ci_mf.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci_mf.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ec.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ec.part_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
      AND ec.part_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: minifigs inside nested sets
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ec.total_quantity * im.quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ec.part_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN current_inventories ci_mf ON ci_mf.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci_mf.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
      AND ec.part_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the color ID for Light Bluish Gray
light_bluish_gray AS (
    SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Light Bluish Gray'
),
-- Get current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all parts at any level
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts in set inventories (non-spare)
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: sets inside sets
    SELECT 
        ep.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ep.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = ep.root_set
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
      AND ep.part_num IS NULL  -- Only expand from set nodes, not part nodes
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: minifigs inside sets
    SELECT 
        ep.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ep.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = ep.root_set
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
      AND ep.part_num IS NULL  -- Only expand from set nodes, not part nodes
)

SELECT DISTINCT s.set_num
FROM sets s
WHERE s.set_num IN (
    -- Direct parts in the set's current inventory
    SELECT ci.set_num
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN light_bluish_gray lbg ON lbg.id = ip.color_id
    WHERE ip.part_num = '3626cpr1336'
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION
    
    -- Parts in nested sets (need recursive expansion)
    SELECT ci_outer.set_num
    FROM current_inventories ci_outer
    WHERE ci_outer.set_num IN (
        -- Find all sets that contain this part/color through nesting
        WITH RECURSIVE nested_contents AS (
            -- Base: direct contents of each set's current inventory
            SELECT 
                ci.set_num AS container_set,
                COALESCE(ins.set_num, im.fig_num) AS contained_item,
                CASE 
                    WHEN ins.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'
                    WHEN im.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'minifig'
                    ELSE NULL
                END AS item_type,
                COALESCE(ins.quantity, im.quantity) AS qty
            FROM current_inventories ci
            LEFT JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = ci.id
            LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
            WHERE ins.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL
            
            UNION ALL
            
            -- Recursive: expand nested sets and minifigs
            SELECT 
                nc.container_set,
                COALESCE(ins2.set_num, im2.fig_num) AS contained_item,
                CASE 
                    WHEN ins2.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'
                    WHEN im2.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'minifig'
                    ELSE NULL
                END AS item_type,
                nc.qty * COALESCE(ins2.quantity, im2.quantity) AS qty
            FROM nested_contents nc
            JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON ci2.set_num = nc.contained_item
            LEFT JOIN inventory_sets ins2 ON ins2.inventory_id = ci2.id
            LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im2 ON im2.inventory_id = ci2.id
            WHERE nc.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
              AND (ins2.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im2.fig_num IS NOT NULL)
        ),
        -- Check which sets/minifigs directly contain the target part
        direct_holders AS (
            SELECT ci.set_num AS holder
            FROM current_inventories ci
            JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
            JOIN light_bluish_gray lbg ON lbg.id = ip.color_id
            WHERE ip.part_num = '3626cpr1336'
              AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
            
            UNION
            
            SELECT im.fig_num AS holder
            FROM inventory_minifigs im
            JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
            JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
            JOIN light_bluish_gray lbg ON lbg.id = ip.color_id
            WHERE ip.part_num = '3626cpr1336'
              AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
        )
        -- Find all root sets that reach these direct holders
        SELECT DISTINCT nc.container_set
        FROM nested_contents nc
        JOIN direct_holders dh ON dh.holder = nc.contained_item
        
        UNION
        
        -- Also include direct holders themselves if they are sets
        SELECT dh.holder
        FROM direct_holders dh
        JOIN sets s ON s.set_num = dh.holder
    )
)
ORDER BY s.set_num;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the theme 'Collectible Minifigures' and all its sub-themes
theme_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Collectible Minifigures'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON t.parent_id = th.id
),
-- Get all sets in 2014 in the theme (including sub-themes)
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2014
    AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_hierarchy)
),
-- Get current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.set_num, MAX(i.id) AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM target_sets)
    GROUP BY i.set_num
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents (sets, minifigs, nested sets, etc.)
-- We track the inventory_id we're currently expanding and multiply quantities
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with current inventories of target sets
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ci.inventory_id,
        1 AS quantity_multiplier
    FROM current_inventories ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets: inventory_sets points to another set, which has its own current inventory
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        i2.id AS inventory_id,
        e.quantity_multiplier * is2.quantity AS quantity_multiplier
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets is2 ON e.inventory_id = is2.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON is2.set_num = i2.set_num
    -- Get current inventory version for the nested set
    WHERE i2.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = i2.set_num
    )
),
-- Get all minifig quantities from all exploded inventories
minifig_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        im.fig_num,
        e.quantity_multiplier * im.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON e.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_quantity), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM minifig_counts
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find all themes under 'Gear' (including itself)
gear_themes AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Gear'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN gear_themes gt ON t.parent_id = gt.id
),
-- Find all sets released in 2013 in Gear theme (including sub-themes)
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2013 AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM gear_themes)
),
-- Recursive function to get all minifigs from a set (including nested)
-- We need to track: original set, current inventory being explored, quantity multiplier
set_minifigs AS (
    -- Anchor: start with target sets' current inventories
    SELECT 
        ts.set_num AS original_set,
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        1 AS multiplier
    FROM target_sets ts
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = ts.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step 1: expand nested sets
    SELECT 
        sm.original_set,
        i2.id AS inventory_id,
        sm.multiplier * iset.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM set_minifigs sm
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = sm.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i2.set_num)
),
-- Now get minifigs from all these inventories
all_minifigs AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.original_set,
        im.fig_num,
        sm.multiplier * im.quantity AS total_qty
    FROM set_minifigs sm
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = sm.inventory_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) FROM all_minifigs
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE theme_hierarchy AS (
    -- Find the 'Super Heroes Marvel' theme and all its sub-themes
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Super Heroes Marvel'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    INNER JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON t.parent_id = th.id
),
sets_2012 AS (
    -- All sets from 2012 in the theme hierarchy
    SELECT s.set_num, s.name
    FROM sets s
    INNER JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON s.theme_id = th.id
    WHERE s.year = 2012
),
current_inventory AS (
    -- Get current inventory (max version) for each set/fig
    SELECT 
        i.id,
        i.set_num,
        i.version,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.set_num ORDER BY i.version DESC) as rn
    FROM inventories i
),
set_contents AS (
    -- Recursive CTE to explode all contents of sets
    -- Start with sets from 2012 and their direct inventory items
    SELECT 
        s.set_num as root_set,
        1 as depth,
        -- For nested sets: track the nested set
        ims.set_num as nested_set_num,
        -- For minifigs: track the minifig
        im.fig_num,
        -- Quantities multiply
        COALESCE(ims.quantity, 1) * COALESCE(im.quantity, 1) as quantity_multiplier,
        -- What type of item this level contributes
        CASE 
            WHEN ims.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'
            WHEN im.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'minifig'
            ELSE 'leaf'
        END as item_type
    FROM sets_2012 s
    LEFT JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num AND ci.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets ims ON ims.inventory_id = ci.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        sc.root_set,
        sc.depth + 1,
        -- Nested sets in the current item's inventory
        ims2.set_num,
        -- Minifigs in the current item's inventory (or from minifig's own inventory)
        COALESCE(im2.fig_num, mf.fig_num),
        -- Multiply quantities along the path
        sc.quantity_multiplier * COALESCE(ims2.quantity, COALESCE(im2.quantity, 1)),
        CASE 
            WHEN ims2.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'
            WHEN COALESCE(im2.fig_num, mf.fig_num) IS NOT NULL THEN 'minifig'
            ELSE 'leaf'
        END
    FROM set_contents sc
    -- If current is a set, get its inventory
    LEFT JOIN current_inventory ci2 ON ci2.set_num = sc.nested_set_num AND ci2.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets ims2 ON ims2.inventory_id = ci2.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im2 ON im2.inventory_id = ci2.id
    -- If current is a minifig, get its inventory (which contains parts, not more minifigs)
    -- But minifigs can have parts in their inventory; we need to check if minifig inventory has minifigs
    -- Actually minifigs don't contain other minifigs per business rules, but let's be safe
    LEFT JOIN current_inventory ci3 ON ci3.set_num = sc.fig_num AND ci3.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs mf ON mf.inventory_id = ci3.id
    WHERE sc.item_type = 'set' OR sc.item_type = 'minifig'
),
-- Get all minifig quantities from the recursive expansion
minifig_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        root_set,
        fig_num,
        quantity_multiplier as total_quantity
    FROM set_contents
    WHERE fig_num IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_quantity), 0) as total_minifigs
FROM minifig_counts
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find all Architecture sub-themes
architecture_themes AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Architecture'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t
    JOIN architecture_themes at ON t.parent_id = at.id
),
-- Sets in Architecture theme (including sub-themes) released in 2016
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num, s.name
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2016
    AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM architecture_themes)
),
-- Current inventory for each set/minifig
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num
    )
),
-- Recursive explosion of contents
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from set inventories
    SELECT 
        ts.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity::BIGINT AS qty
    FROM target_sets ts
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ts.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: parts from minifigs in sets
    SELECT 
        ts.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (im.quantity * ip.quantity)::BIGINT AS qty
    FROM target_sets ts
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ts.set_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci2 ON ci2.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci2.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (ec.qty * ip.quantity)::BIGINT AS qty
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ec.part_num  -- part_num here is actually a set_num from previous level
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets -> minifigs
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (ec.qty * im.quantity * ip.quantity)::BIGINT AS qty
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ec.part_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci2 ON ci2.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci2.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets -> nested sets
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        iset.set_num AS part_num,
        NULL::INT AS color_id,
        (ec.qty * iset.quantity)::BIGINT AS qty
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ec.part_num
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
)
-- Sum all quantities
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_parts
FROM (
    SELECT root_set, part_num, color_id, qty
    FROM exploded_contents
    WHERE part_num IS NOT NULL  -- filter out any NULL part_nums from set-only rows
    UNION ALL
    -- Need to also include parts from nested sets that are identified by set_num in inventory_sets
    -- The recursive CTE above handles this through the recursive steps
    -- But we need to make sure we capture the initial nested sets too
    SELECT 
        ts.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (iset.quantity * ip.quantity)::BIGINT AS qty
    FROM target_sets ts
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ts.set_num
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci2 ON ci2.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci2.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
) all_parts;
```

```sql
    FROM sets s
```

```sql
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents (parts, nested sets, minifigs)

    -- Base: start with sets' current inventories
    SELECT

        ci.inventory_id,
        1 AS quantity_multiplier,

        ci.set_num AS item_id

        ci2.id AS inventory_id,
        ec.quantity_multiplier * iset.quantity AS quantity_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded_contents ec

    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON iset.set_num = ci2.set_num
    WHERE ec.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step 2: expand minifigs (from inventory_minifigs)
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ci2.id AS inventory_id,
        ec.quantity_multiplier * im.quantity AS quantity_multiplier,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded_contents ec
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current inventory version for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        i.set_num,
        i.version
    FROM inventories i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),

-- Base set parts from inventory_parts (excluding spares)
base_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
),

-- Recursive expansion: nested sets
nested_sets AS (
    -- Base: direct nested sets in root inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        iset.set_num AS nested_set_num,
        iset.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets within nested sets
    SELECT 
        ns.root_set,
        iset2.set_num AS nested_set_num,
        ns.multiplier * iset2.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM nested_sets ns
    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON ci2.set_num = ns.nested_set_num
    JOIN inventory_sets iset2 ON iset2.inventory_id = ci2.inventory_id
),

-- Parts from nested sets (expanded recursively)
nested_set_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ns.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ns.multiplier * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM nested_sets ns
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ns.nested_set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
),

-- Minifigs in root inventories
root_minifigs AS (
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        im.fig_num,
        im.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
),

-- Minifigs in nested sets (need to expand nested sets to find their minifigs)
nested_set_minifigs AS (
    SELECT 
        ns.root_set,
        im.fig_num,
        ns.multiplier * im.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM nested_sets ns
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ns.nested_set_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
),

-- All minifig references combined
all_minifigs AS (
    SELECT root_set, fig_num, multiplier FROM root_minifigs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT root_set, fig_num, multiplier FROM nested_set_minifigs
),

-- Parts from minifigs
minifig_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        am.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        am.multiplier * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM all_minifigs am
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = am.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
),

-- All parts combined
all_parts AS (
    SELECT root_set, part_num, color_id, qty FROM base_parts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT root_set, part_num, color_id, qty FROM nested_set_parts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT root_set, part_num, color_id, qty FROM minifig_parts
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ap.qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM all_parts ap
JOIN sets s ON s.set_num = ap.root_set
JOIN colors c ON c.id = ap.color_id
WHERE s.year = 2013
  AND ap.part_num = '63868'
  AND c.name = 'White';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find the theme 'Super Heroes DC' and all its sub-themes
theme_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Super Heroes DC'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON t.parent_id = th.id
),
-- Get all sets in 2022 matching the theme
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON s.theme_id = th.id
    WHERE s.year = 2022
),
-- Find current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
    WHERE i.set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM target_sets)
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents (parts, nested sets, minifigs)
-- We track: inventory_id, multiplier (quantity along path), item type
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with current inventories of target sets
    SELECT 
        ci.inventory_id,
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        1 AS multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        ci.set_num AS item_id
    FROM current_inventories ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts directly in inventory
    SELECT 
        e.inventory_id,
        e.root_set,
        e.multiplier * ip.quantity AS multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num || '|' || ip.color_id AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: need to find their current inventory and recurse
    SELECT 
        ci2.id AS inventory_id,
        e.root_set,
        e.multiplier * iset.quantity AS multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories ci2 ON ci2.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv2 ON ci2.set_num = mv2.set_num AND ci2.version = mv2.max_version
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: need to find their inventory and recurse (they contain parts)
    SELECT 
        ci2.id AS inventory_id,
        e.root_set,
        e.multiplier * im.quantity AS multiplier,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories ci2 ON ci2.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv2 ON ci2.set_num = mv2.set_num AND ci2.version = mv2.max_version
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts in minifig inventories
    SELECT 
        e.inventory_id,
        e.root_set,
        e.multiplier * ip.quantity AS multiplier,
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num || '|' || ip.color_id AS item_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'minifig'
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
),
-- Extract distinct colors from all parts found
part_colors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(item_id, '|', 2) AS INT) AS color_id
    FROM exploded
    WHERE item_type = 'part'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT color_id) AS distinct_colors
FROM part_colors
```

```sql
        ci.inventory_id
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT

        'set' AS item_type,

        CAST(iset.quantity AS BIGINT) AS qty,

    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs

        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id,
        NULL AS color_id,
        CAST(im.quantity AS BIGINT) AS qty,
        ci.inventory_id
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id

        root_set,

        item_id AS original_id

        CASE 
            WHEN ip.part_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'part'
            WHEN iset.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'
            WHEN im.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'minifig'

        re.original_type,

            i.set_num,
            NULL AS fig_num
        FROM inventories i

    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = curr_inv.inventory_id
```

```sql
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
),

    SELECT

        NULL AS part_num,
        NULL AS color_id,
        iset.quantity AS multiplier,
        TRUE AS is_nested_set,
        iset.set_num AS nested_set_num
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id

    WHERE rc.is_nested_set = TRUE

    WHERE rc.is_nested_set = TRUE

    -- Recursive: minifigs within nested sets
    SELECT

        NULL AS part_num,
```

```sql
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (is.quantity * ip.quantity) AS qty,
        TRUE AS from_nested
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_sets is ON is.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = is.set_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON mv.set_num = i.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE

    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find the color_id for White
white_color AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id
    FROM colors
    WHERE name = 'White'
),

-- Get current inventory version for each set
set_current_version AS (
    SELECT parent_num AS set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
    GROUP BY parent_num
),

-- Get current inventory version for each minifig
minifig_current_version AS (
    SELECT parent_num AS fig_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'minifig'
    GROUP BY parent_num
),

-- Recursive expansion: start from all sets with their current inventory
-- We track: the original set we're exploring from, and the current item we're at
recursive_contents AS (
    -- Base case: direct contents of each set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        scv.set_num AS root_set,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.color_id,
        uc.qty,
        uc.is_spare
    FROM set_current_version scv
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'set' 
        AND uc.parent_num = scv.set_num 
        AND uc.version = scv.max_version
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        rc.root_set,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.color_id,
        rc.qty * uc.qty AS qty,
        uc.is_spare
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    -- Join with u_composition where current item is the parent
    JOIN u_composition uc ON 
        -- Match parent kind and num
        ((rc.child_kind = 'set' AND uc.parent_kind = 'set' AND uc.parent_num = rc.child_num)
         OR (rc.child_kind = 'minifig' AND uc.parent_kind = 'minifig' AND uc.parent_num = rc.child_num))
        -- Use current version of the parent
        AND uc.version = CASE 
            WHEN rc.child_kind = 'set' THEN (SELECT max_version FROM set_current_version WHERE set_num = rc.child_num)
            WHEN rc.child_kind = 'minifig' THEN (SELECT max_version FROM minifig_current_version WHERE fig_num = rc.child_num)
        END
    WHERE rc.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')  -- Only expand sets and minifigs, not parts
)
```

```sql
    GROUP BY parent_num
```

```sql
    SELECT parent_num AS fig_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'minifig'
    GROUP BY parent_num
),

-- Recursive expansion: start from all sets, traverse down through nested sets and minifigs
-- We track the original set we're exploring from, and the accumulated quantity
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of sets (parts, nested sets, minifigs)
    SELECT 
        sc.parent_num AS root_set,
        sc.child_kind,
        sc.child_num,
        sc.color_id,
        sc.qty AS total_qty,
        sc.is_spare
    FROM u_composition sc
    JOIN set_current_version cv ON sc.parent_num = cv.set_num AND sc.version = cv.max_version
    WHERE sc.parent_kind = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        ep.root_set,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.color_id,
        ep.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        uc.is_spare
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN u_composition uc ON (
        -- If current node is a set, expand its current inventory
        (ep.child_kind = 'set' AND uc.parent_kind = 'set' AND uc.parent_num = ep.child_num
         AND uc.version = (SELECT max_version FROM set_current_version WHERE set_num = ep.child_num))
        OR
        -- If current node is a minifig, expand its current inventory
        (ep.child_kind = 'minifig' AND uc.parent_kind = 'minifig' AND uc.parent_num = ep.child_num
         AND uc.version = (SELECT max_version FROM minifig_current_version WHERE fig_num = ep.child_num))
    )
    WHERE ep.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')  -- Only expand sets and minifigs, not parts
)
```

```sql
    JOIN set_current_version scv ON e.fig_num = scv.set_num AND uc.version = scv.version
    WHERE uc.child_kind = 'minifig'

        e.set_num,
        uc.child_num AS fig_num,
        e.qty * uc.qty AS qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition uc ON e.fig_num = uc.parent_num AND uc.parent_kind = 'set'
    JOIN set_current_version scv ON e.fig_num = scv.set_num AND uc.version = scv.version
    WHERE uc.child_kind = 'set'

recursive_expansion AS (
    -- Start with sets in Advent theme in 2021, initial multiplier 1
    SELECT 
        s.set_num AS root_set,
        uc.child_num AS current_num,
        uc.child_kind AS current_kind,
        uc.qty AS multiplier

    JOIN set_current_version scv ON s.set_num = scv.set_num AND uc.version = scv.version
    WHERE s.year = 2021

    SELECT 
        re.root_set,
        uc.child_num AS current_num,
        uc.child_kind AS current_kind,
        re.multiplier * uc.qty AS multiplier
    FROM recursive_expansion re
    JOIN u_composition uc ON re.current_num = uc.parent_num AND 
        CASE re.current_kind
            WHEN 'set' THEN uc.parent_kind = 'set'
            WHEN 'minifig' THEN uc.parent_kind = 'minifig'
        END
    LEFT JOIN set_current_version scv ON re.current_kind = 'set' AND re.current_num = scv.set_num AND uc.version = scv.version
```

```sql
    FROM u_composition
```
```sql
    WHERE parent_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
```

```sql
    FROM current_inventory ci
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN uc.child_kind = 'part' THEN uc.child_num ELSE NULL END AS part_num,
        uc.color_id,
        CASE WHEN uc.child_kind = 'part' THEN rp.parent_qty * uc.qty ELSE NULL END AS qty,
        uc.is_spare
    FROM recursive_parts rp
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'set' AND uc.parent_num = rp.set_or_fig_num

      AND uc.child_kind = 'part'
      AND NOT uc.is_spare
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: continue into nested sets (non-parts, current inventory)

        uc.child_num AS set_or_fig_num,
        NULL::INT AS color_id,

    WHERE rp.set_or_fig_num IS NOT NULL  -- it's a set

      AND uc.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
```

```sql
        child_kind,
        child_num,
        color_id,
        qty,
        -- is_direct is true if this row is directly in 10785-1's inventory

        -- For tracking origin: true if directly in 10785-1, false if from nested

    WHERE parent_kind = 'set' AND parent_num = '10785-1'

        c.child_num,
        c.color_id,
        -- Quantity multiplies along the path
        e.qty * c.qty as qty,
        e.is_direct_parent,
        -- Once we go into a nested set or minifig, it's no longer from direct inventory
        FALSE as from_direct_inventory
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition c ON (
        -- Join with current inventory of nested sets/minifigs
        (e.child_kind = 'set' AND c.parent_kind = 'set' AND c.parent_num = e.child_num)
        OR 
        (e.child_kind = 'minifig' AND c.parent_kind = 'minifig' AND c.parent_num = e.child_num)

        FROM u_composition
```

```cypher
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '45801-1'})-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(i:Inventory)
WITH s, i, max(i.version) AS max_version
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory {version: max_version})
WITH inv

// Get direct parts (not spare) from set's own inventory
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[hp:HAS_PART {is_spare: false}]->(:Part)
WITH inv, coalesce(sum(hp.qty), 0) AS direct_parts_qty

// Get all nested items (sets and minifigs) with their quantities from set's own inventory
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[cs:CONTAINS_SET]->(nested_set:Set)
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, 
     collect({item: nested_set, qty: cs.qty, type: 'set'}) AS nested_sets,
     [] AS nested_minifigs

OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[cm:CONTAINS_MINIFIG]->(nested_minifig:Minifig)
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, 
     nested_sets + collect({item: nested_minifig, qty: cm.qty, type: 'minifig'}) AS all_nested

// Unwind nested items
UNWIND coalesce(all_nested, []) AS nested_item

// For each nested set, recursively get its total part quantity (current inventory, all levels, no spare)
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, nested_item
WHERE nested_item.type = 'set'
MATCH (nested_set:Set {set_num: nested_item.item.set_num})-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(ns_inv:Inventory)
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, nested_item, nested_set, max(ns_inv.version) AS ns_max_version
MATCH (nested_set)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(ns_inv_current:Inventory {version: ns_max_version})

// Recursively get all parts from nested set (all levels)
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (ns_inv_current)-[e:CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*0..10]->(target)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(target_inv:Inventory)
WHERE target:Set OR target:Minifig
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, nested_item, ns_inv_current, 
     CASE 
       WHEN target IS NULL THEN ns_inv_current
       ELSE target_inv
     END AS final_inv,
     CASE 
       WHEN target IS NULL THEN 1
       ELSE list_product(properties(rels(e), 'qty'))
     END AS path_mult

// Get parts from each final inventory
OPTIONAL MATCH (final_inv)-[hp:HAS_PART {is_spare: false}]->(:Part)
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, nested_item, 
     coalesce(sum(hp.qty * path_mult), 0) AS nested_set_total_parts

WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, sum(nested_item.qty * nested_set_total_parts) AS nested_sets_contribution

// For each nested minifig, get its total part quantity
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, nested_sets_contribution
MATCH (inv)-[cm:CONTAINS_MINIFIG]->(minifig:Minifig)
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, nested_sets_contribution, minifig, cm.qty AS mf_qty
MATCH (minifig)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(mf_inv:Inventory)
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, nested_sets_contribution, minifig, mf_qty, max(mf_inv.version) AS mf_max_version
MATCH (minifig)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(mf_inv_current:Inventory {version: mf_max_version})

// Recursively get all parts from minifig (all levels through nested sets inside minifig)
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (mf_inv_current)-[e:CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*0..10]->(target)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(target_inv:Inventory)
WHERE target:Set OR target:Minifig
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, nested_sets_contribution, mf_qty,
     CASE 
       WHEN target IS NULL THEN mf_inv_current
       ELSE target_inv
     END AS final_inv,
     CASE 
       WHEN target IS NULL THEN 1
       ELSE list_product(properties(rels(e), 'qty'))
     END AS path_mult

OPTIONAL MATCH (final_inv)-[hp:HAS_PART {is_spare: false}]->(:Part)
WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, nested_sets_contribution, mf_qty,
     coalesce(sum(hp.qty * path_mult), 0) AS mf_total_parts

WITH inv, direct_parts_qty, nested_sets_contribution, sum(mf_qty * mf_total_parts) AS minifigs_contribution

// Calculate total and percentage
WITH direct_parts_qty, nested_sets_contribution, minifigs_contribution,
     direct_parts_qty + nested_sets_contribution + minifigs_contribution AS total_parts,
     nested_sets_contribution + minifigs_contribution AS indirect_parts

RETURN CASE 
         WHEN total_parts = 0 THEN 0.00
         ELSE round((indirect_parts * 100.0 / total_parts) * 100) / 100
       END AS percentage
```
